name: Chat App
tagline: Cross-platform messenger prototype for iOS, Android and the web, built with Expo
role: Cross-platform prototype by the Softwhere team

scenes.title: Chat list and conversations
scenes.body: Each chat keeps its unsent draft, saved across restarts; search filters by name or message.

scenes.title: Long-press quick actions
scenes.body: Press and hold (right-click on web) to open the quick-action menu, with a nested timed-mute submenu.

scenes.title: Peek without opening
scenes.body: Hold an avatar to preview the conversation in a floating card; let go and you are back in the list.

scenes.title: Split view on wide screens
scenes.body: From 900 px wide, the same code shows chats beside the open conversation, light or dark to match the system.
